From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chang <olivia.chang@grafana.com>, Sanjay Patel <sanjay@datadog.com>

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Logging add-ons BOM + evidence request (Grafana / Datadog renewal)

Team / Olivia / Sanjay —

As discussed in the renewals sync, we have two upcoming line-item renewals that need coordinated procurement and evidence for security review: Grafana Cloud long‑term retention add-on and Datadog log rehydration/retention tiers. To move forward with a consolidated RFP and legal check, please send the following by EOD Fri 2026-08-28:

1) Bill of materials (SKU-level) for the retention/add-on line items and any optional features tied to archival or rehydration.
2) Firm pricing table for: per-GB/month retention extension, egress/rehydration, and any minimum commit tiers (1/6/12 months). If you can include a committed-spend discount schedule, include that too.
3) Security/compliance artifacts (SOC 2 type II date, DPA pointer, encryption at rest/in transit details, key management options).
4) Any contract redlines commonly requested (sample MSA clauses for data residency, egress, termination/rehydration).

Attached: procurement_worksheet_v3.xlsx (procurement team template). Marissa — we will use this to capture pricing and TCO comparison. Kimberly — flagging legal items you'll want to review. Karthik — please call out the query/ML telemetry volumes we should use for sizing (I appended last quarter's volume to the worksheet).

Goal: pick a vendor or hybrid approach and finalize commercial terms by Sep 3 so Finance can approve a commit before month-end.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Sr. Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: procurement_worksheet_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Subject: Re: Logging add-ons BOM + evidence request (Grafana / Datadog renewal)

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick first pass from Grafana Cloud below; attaching a BOM PDF and a short pricing matrix.

What I'm including now:
- grafana_bom_v1.pdf (attached) — SKUs for long-term retention (SeriesArchive), log ingestion tiers, and rehydration calls.
- Pricing highlights: SeriesArchive base = $0.012/GB/mo for 13–90 day tier; $0.009/GB/mo for committed 12-month 500TB+; rehydration API = $0.04/GB retrieved. Committed spend discount: 10% at $150k/year, 15% at $300k/year.
- Security artifacts: SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and DPA link are in our secure share; I'll send the link to Kimberly directly (per your legal needs).
- Notes: For large archives we recommend the Glacier‑like cold tier, which has slower rehydration but lower cost — worth modeling if you expect infrequent restores.

If you want, we can do a short 30-min pricing walk-through tomorrow morning to explain commit breakpoints and tradeoffs.

Best,
Olivia Chang
Account Lead, Grafana Cloud
olivia.chang@grafana.com

Attachments: grafana_bom_v1.pdf (SKU/BOM), grafana_pricing_matrix_aug25.csv (pricing stub)

Hi Ben —

Appreciate the heads-up. Attached is a Datadog quote for log retention and rehydration (datadog_quote_aug25.pdf). Key callouts: 
- Pricing model is still ingest + retention + retrieval. For retention we offer negotiated tiers: 30/90/365/indefinite with stepped unit pricing. Example: 90‑day tier for your volumes is ~$0.018/GB/mo, 365‑day drops to ~$0.010/GB/mo with a 12‑month commit.
- Retrieval/rehydration: $0.035/GB for bulk; $0.09/GB for API ad‑hoc restores.
- Egress & integration note: If you plan to route rehydrated data to another cloud, add egress bandwidth fees (we've line-itemed those in the quote).
- Compliance: SOC 2 Type II cert and DPA are available via our vendor portal: https://datadog.com/vendor-portal/teams/redwood/secure-artifacts. I'll copy legal on the portal link.

If you want to compare side-by-side I can produce a normalized TCO with your worksheet numbers. Happy to sync Fri morning.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
Solutions Engineering Manager, Datadog
sanjay@datadog.com

Attachments: datadog_quote_aug25.pdf (commercial quote)

Olivia / Sanjay —

Thanks for the quick responses and the initial artifacts. A couple of legal/security asks to close before we can issue any purchase order or commit to a multi‑year discount: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: please confirm the reporting period and whether subservice organizations are covered (we'll need the most recent report PDF).
2) DPA + DSR procedures: point me to the executed DPA; if there are any standard data subject request procedures (contact, SLA), include them.
3) Encryption & KMS: confirm whether keys are customer-managed (BYOK) or vendor-managed and provide an architectural diagram (one page) showing encryption at rest/in transit.
4) Rehydration SLA & egress runbook: we need a short egress/rehydration runbook with expected timelines for bulk restores and a summary of costs applied.

If these are available in a secure share, please provide the Drive link or a vendor portal pointer that Kimberly can access (kimberly_park@redwood.com). We will treat the SOC 2 and KMS details as gating items for any extended discount beyond standard list.

Appreciate it —
Kimberly Park
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Quick summary / next steps for the group: 

- Deliverables expected from vendors by EOD Thu 2026-09-02: finalized SKU-level BOM, signed pricing matrix (with commit breakpoints), access to SOC 2 Type II, and a one-page KMS/encryption diagram.
- Procurement action: Marissa will populate the procurement_worksheet_v3.xlsx with both vendor rows and normalized TCO. Karthik — please drop the projected monthly GB numbers in the "expected retrievals" tab by Thursday.
- Legal gating: Kimberly will confirm whether the SOC 2 and KMS answers satisfy our DPA requirements. If any vendor cannot provide customer-managed KMS or sufficient rehydration SLAs, we will flag that as a commercial risk.

If vendors can provide a draft redline to an MSA (or identify the most common redline points), that will speed up the contracting timeline; otherwise we will propose a short addendum for retention/rehydration terms. Proposed decision window: Sept 6–8 (commercial + legal sign-off).

Ben
